notes: 2026.6.35, two header variants from the same CLI. Native route (the openai provider's base URL names api.openai.com, as a gateway on the real endpoint sees it): 'originator: openclaw', 'user-agent: openclaw/<version>', a 'version' header, and 'store: false' in the body. Any other base URL (a custom provider id or the openai provider with a proxy URL): the stock openai-node user-agent 'OpenAI/JS <sdk>' and no attribution headers or store; a W3C traceparent header is sent on both. Identity ('You are a personal assistant running inside OpenClaw'), the 33-tool set, max_completion_tokens and stream_options are identical across both variants and across the first turn, after the tool call and the follow-up in the same --session-id.
